response.justification: Bogdan has extensive software development experience with a strong background in C and C++ (including at National Instruments), but his recent work heavily emphasizes JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, and other languages, with minimal direct C++ or SQL experience in the last 5 years. His domain exposure is primarily in general software and web development rather than capital markets or fixed income systems.
strengths: Strong foundational C/C++ experience (5+ years, including Windows development)
Proven ability to work in diverse tech stacks (full-stack, embedded, real-time systems)
Demonstrated track record of optimizing performance in low-latency applications
concerns: Limited recent C++ development (last 5 years focused on Node.js, TypeScript, and Dlang)
No clear domain expertise in capital markets, fixed income, or investment banking
No mention of SQL Server or Oracle experience in recent roles

key_factors.factor: Domain expertise in capital markets/fixed income
